title: NS-P3 Lean: extremal relations and actual Tor Betti numbers
description:
Lean companion to Extremal relations and Betti numbers of four-generated numerical semigroups. This version integrates the adopted 21-page manuscript development and the actual categorical Tor / total Betti extension. It includes 575 Lean source files with the exact Lean toolchain and nine dependency Git pins.

Over every field with carrier Type0, the development proves actual Tor finiteness, identities (1, eta, eta+tau-1, tau), higher vanishing, field independence, simultaneous upper bounds, known-family tuples and attained extremal windows. It does not determine the exact second/third Betti maxima or classify all Betti tuples.

Existing new-module evidence is same-host, against a matching-source warm V03 baseline and cached dependencies; it is not a dependency-cold, full-baseline or independent-host replay. Substantial ChatGPT/Codex assistance covered research, proofs, Lean, verification and writing. AI checks are author-side checks, not independent human peer review. Original software is Apache 2.0; the included preprint PDF/TeX is separately CC BY 4.0.
